description:
Get cross-species homologue information for a target.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_homologues — one record = one homologue of one human gene in one species.
Key: id, homologues[].speciesId, homologues[].targetGeneId, homologues[].homologyType.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: one row = one item (one homologue of one human gene in one species); `_vbt.total` counts items.
Rows with unknown queryPercentageIdentity are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Ensembl Compara homologues integrated by OT 25.09; a missing species means no homologue listed.

min_identity.description: Keeps rows with homologues[].queryPercentageIdentity >= this value; unknown values never pass.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
